connectorUiConfig.title: QCrypton PQC Scanner Agent
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [QCrypton PQC Scanner Agent](https://www.qcrypton.com/) data connector ingests post-quantum cryptography readiness findings from internal network scans into Microsoft Sentinel through the QCrypton API. The Scanner Agent probes TLS posture on VNet-internal Azure endpoints and network appliances including F5 BIG-IP, Check Point, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, and Fortinet FortiGate. Findings include quantum-vulnerable certificates, weak TLS configurations, classical key exchanges, and PQC readiness status.

graphQueries.metricName: Total internal network PQ readiness findings received
graphQueries.baseQuery:
PQReadiness_CL
| where Metadata contains '"source":"scanner-agent"' or ResourceType has_any ('F5', 'CheckPoint', 'PaloAlto', 'Cisco', 'Fortinet')

sampleQueries.description: All quantum-vulnerable internal findings in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| where ResourceType has_any ('F5', 'CheckPoint', 'PaloAlto', 'Cisco', 'Fortinet', 'Azure/AppService', 'Azure/ContainerApp', 'Azure/FrontDoor', 'Azure/ApiManagement')
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, ResourceType, AssetKind, Algorithm, PostureReason, RiskScore
| order by RiskScore desc

sampleQueries.description: Appliance TLS posture summary by vendor
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResourceType has_any ('F5', 'CheckPoint', 'PaloAlto', 'Cisco', 'Fortinet')
| summarize Vulnerable = countif(QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'), Compliant = countif(QuantumPosture == 'compliant') by ResourceType

sampleQueries.description: Endpoints with PQC hybrid key exchange negotiated
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where QuantumPosture == 'compliant'
| where Metadata contains 'pqc_hybrid_key_exchange' or Metadata contains 'f5_pqc_engine_active'
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, ResourceType, Algorithm, PostureReason

dataTypes.name: PQReadiness_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PQReadiness_CL
| where Metadata contains '"source":"scanner-agent"' or ResourceType has_any ('F5', 'CheckPoint', 'PaloAlto', 'Cisco', 'Fortinet')
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: Connect QCrypton PQC Scanner Agent to Microsoft Sentinel

parameters.content: This connector polls the QCrypton PQC Scanner Agent API to retrieve post-quantum cryptography readiness findings from internal network scans and ingest them into the **PQReadiness_CL** table in your Log Analytics workspace.

#### 1. Deploy the Scanner Agent
Deploy the QCrypton PQC Scanner Agent as an Azure Container App in your VNet. Follow the [deployment guide](https://www.qcrypton.com/docs/scanner-agent) to configure appliance targets (F5 BIG-IP, Check Point, Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet) and Azure endpoint discovery.

#### 2. API Key
Obtain your QCrypton API key from the [QCrypton Portal](https://portal.qcrypton.com). Navigate to **Settings > API Keys** and generate a key with read access to agent scan findings.

#### 3. API Server URL
Enter the base URL of your QCrypton API server. The default is `https://api.qcrypton.com`. If you use a dedicated or regional instance, enter the URL provided by QCrypton.

parameters.label: QCrypton API Server URL
parameters.name: apiServerUrl
parameters.description: Enter the QCrypton API base URL. Do not include a trailing slash or path.
